title: Ежедневные задания по русскому
delivery: one challenge per day; 5–10 minutes; no new grammar required

challenge_rules.streak_policy: award consistency points but never lock educational content behind a streak

challenges.title: Identity Ping
challenges.prompt: Say your name and ask another person’s name three times, changing the names.
challenges.target_pattern: Меня зовут ____. А как тебя зовут?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Vowel Radar
challenges.prompt: Record yourself saying а, е, и, о, у, then one word for each vowel.
challenges.target_pattern: а е и о у; аптека, еда, игра, окно, улыбка
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Origin Exchange
challenges.prompt: Answer where you are from and ask the question back.
challenges.target_pattern: Я из ____. А ты откуда?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Article Hunt
challenges.prompt: Find or imagine five objects and label each with мужской род, женский род, or множественное число.
challenges.target_pattern: книга; стол; карты; дома; окно
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Human Snapshot
challenges.prompt: Describe one person with a noun and two agreeing adjectives.
challenges.target_pattern: Это мой друг/моя подруга. Он/Она ____ и ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Question Chain
challenges.prompt: Ask что, кто, где, and как questions about one scene.
challenges.target_pattern: Что это? Кто это? Где это? Как (он/она)?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: First Contact
challenges.prompt: Complete a 45-second introduction without reading.
challenges.target_pattern: Привет. Меня зовут ____. Я из ____. Приятно познакомиться.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Room Scan
challenges.prompt: Describe three objects using есть, находится, or находятся.
challenges.target_pattern: Есть ____. ____ находится ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Verb Sprint
challenges.prompt: Conjugate говорить, изучать, and работать for я, ты, and он/она aloud.
challenges.target_pattern: говорю/говоришь/говорит; изучаю/изучаешь/изучает; работаю/работаешь/работает
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: People Map
challenges.prompt: Describe three people using мой, твой, его/ее, or наш/наша.
challenges.target_pattern: Мой ____. Твой ____. Наш/Наша ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Yes/No Flip
challenges.prompt: Turn three positive sentences into questions and answer each positively and negatively.
challenges.target_pattern: Ты говоришь? Да, я говорю. Нет, я не говорю.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Preposition Walk
challenges.prompt: Describe where you are, where you go, and with whom.
challenges.target_pattern: Я в ____. Я иду в ____. Я иду с ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Routine Relay
challenges.prompt: Give a four-step routine using сначала, потом, затем, and наконец.
challenges.target_pattern: Сначала ____. Потом ____. Затем ____. Наконец ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Daily Briefing
challenges.prompt: Give a 60-second report about home, routine, and one negative fact.
challenges.target_pattern: Я живу в ____. Сначала ____. Я не ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Café Recall
challenges.prompt: Order two items and reject one item politely.
challenges.target_pattern: Можно мне ____, пожалуйста. Нет, спасибо.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Help Signal
challenges.prompt: Ask for help, then respond that you can or cannot help.
challenges.target_pattern: Вы можете мне помочь? Да, могу. / Пока не могу.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Number Ladder
challenges.prompt: Count 1–30, then schedule two actions at different times.
challenges.target_pattern: Я учусь в __ часов. Я работаю в __ часов.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Market Mission
challenges.prompt: Point to two items, ask the price of one, and thank the seller.
challenges.target_pattern: Я хочу этот/эту ____. Сколько стоит? Спасибо.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Preference Pulse
challenges.prompt: Say one singular preference, one plural preference, and one dislike.
challenges.target_pattern: Мне нравится ____. Мне нравятся ____. Мне не нравится ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Needs and Wants
challenges.prompt: Combine хочу, нужно, and мне нравится in one mini-dialogue.
challenges.target_pattern: Я хочу ____. Мне нужно ____. Мне нравится ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Tomorrow Board
challenges.prompt: State three plans for tomorrow and ask someone else’s plan.
challenges.target_pattern: Завтра я буду ____. А ты что будешь делать?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Map Route
challenges.prompt: Give a two-step route to a familiar place.
challenges.target_pattern: Идите прямо и поверните на ____. Это рядом.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Glue Words
challenges.prompt: Join four pairs of sentences using и, но, потому что, or также.
challenges.target_pattern: Мне нравится __, потому что ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Irregular Five
challenges.prompt: Use быть, находиться, у меня есть, идти, and делать in five different sentences.
challenges.target_pattern: Я ____. Я нахожусь ____. У меня есть ____. Я иду ____. Я делаю ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Turn-Taking
challenges.prompt: Answer a question, ask А ты?, and ask one follow-up.
challenges.target_pattern: Ответ. А ты? Что ты любишь делать?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Three-Pass Listening
challenges.prompt: Listen to a short Russian clip three times: situation, facts, useful phrase.
challenges.target_pattern: Ситуация: ____. Факты: ____. Фраза: ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Paraphrase Rescue
challenges.prompt: Explain one unknown object using вещь, для, and a known verb.
challenges.target_pattern: Это вещь для ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Final Voice Note
challenges.prompt: Record a 2–3 minute everyday Russian voice note using identity, routine, preference, plan, and repair.
challenges.target_pattern: Привет. Меня зовут ____. Я из ____. Мне нравится ____. Завтра я буду ____. Можете повторить?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.
